answer: An identity's answers must stay mutually consistent across epochs: a claim contradicted by its own later submission voids both, and the pair is flagged at replay. The trellis history is re-read at each close, kernel lists the contradictions, and glacier records the voided pairs. A farm that generates text cheaply cannot hold a coherent position over 10 epochs, so that its own output eventually convicts it. The deposit is 31 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
